name: Econlockhatchee River Paddling Trail, Little Big Econ State Forest
coordinateNote: Entrance or parking coordinates from the November 12, 2026 gap review.
navigationDestination: Little Big Econ State Forest Headquarters canoe launch, 1350 Snow Hill Road, Geneva, FL 32732
navigationNote: Drive to the listed entrance; follow the access description on arrival.
experience: Paddle the state-designated trail: CR 419 bridge to the forest headquarters launch is 8 miles, and the full trail runs 19 miles to the SR 46 bridge on the St. Johns. Tannic, not clear water. Check the USGS gauge: downed trees in the upper section below 11 ft, flood stage above 18 ft.
cost: Fee required at the forest headquarters launch (DEP guide); state forest day pass $2 (FDACS)
access: Headquarters launch: walk about 660 ft from the pavilion parking to the river; gates close at sunset; overnight parking allowed. Bring your own boat and shuttle (no outfitter verified here). Passes via ReserveAmerica, not sold at the office.

conditions.summary: Forest open sunrise to sunset. Effective Oct 1, 2026 the bridges linking Little Big Econ and Bronson state forests are closed to all traffic for repairs (affects hiking/horse trails, not the river). Hunting occurs east of Snow Hill Road; check WMA dates. (source dated read 2026-11-12)
